prompt: Locked-off static camera, the frame never moves. One continuous shot, no cuts. Cheap colour film, soft grain, warm pub lamps, teal rain on the windows. The woman in the burgundy cardigan holds the white card perfectly still beside her head; its printed number stays crisp, flat and unchanged for the whole shot. She speaks into the microphone, lips moving naturally, a dry half-smile. In the first seconds the man in the flat cap rubs his brow and lets his head sink, and the woman in the navy hijab presses her face deeper into her hands. The lad in the hi-vis vest sits still, watching her. Thanks.
